title: Surreal Desert Dreamscape
description: A circular frame decorated with flowers, bones, and trinkets encloses a surreal desert scene. Inside, a red figure stands before a large green moon under a dramatic orange sky with aurora-like light, while a green spiral staircase rises from the sand beside a body of water.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape viewed through a large circular frame heavily decorated with flowers, bones, shells, and trinkets. Inside the frame a red humanoid figure stands on sand dunes in front of a giant green moon. A glowing orange and red sky with aurora-like formations above. A green spiral staircase emerges from the sand and water on the right. Mystical and dreamlike atmosphere with geometric shapes floating in the air.
